mindfulness/mountain.welcome: Welcome... let's begin this mindfulness meditation... settle into a comfortable position... feel the ground beneath you as you allow your eyes to close or soften... take a slow breath in... and as you breathe out, let your shoulders relax...
mindfulness/mountain.completion: Thank you for sharing this time... as you gently return, carry the steadiness of the mountain with you... know that you can return to this calm presence whenever you need...
segments: Bring your awareness to your breath... not changing anything, just noticing the natural rhythm... as you inhale, imagine the broad base of a mountain... solid and grounded... and as you exhale, let any tension drift away like clouds around the peak...

Continue breathing gently... with each in-breath, feel the mountain's stillness within you... steady and unchanging... and with each out-breath, sense the air moving over the slopes... cool and calm... allow your body to settle like rock, solid and at ease...

Now bring a gentle awareness to your whole body... the mountain is not just an image, but a felt sense of presence... as you breathe in, feel the cool air at the peak... as you breathe out, let warmth spread down the slopes... notice any tightness or ease... simply observing without changing anything...

mindfulness/ocean.welcome: Welcome to this mindfulness meditation. We'll settle together by an ocean beach, allowing the rhythm of the waves to guide us into a calm and present state. There is no need to change anything about yourself; simply arrive as you are.
mindfulness/ocean.completion: As this meditation comes to a close, carry the gentle awareness of the ocean with you. Notice how the breath continues to flow, like waves meeting the shore. When you are ready, slowly bring your attention back to the space around you, feeling refreshed and at ease.
segments: Allow your eyes to close or soften your gaze... Take a slow breath in through the nose... and let it out with a sigh, releasing any tension... Imagine the soft sand beneath you, the sound of waves nearby... Breathe in the fresh ocean air... and let the out-breath carry away any busyness... Feel the rhythm of the sea matching the rhythm of your breath...

Now bring your awareness to the points of contact with the ground... Feel the support beneath you, steady like the sand... With the next breath in, notice the cool air at the nostrils... and as you breathe out, feel the body soften a little more... Listen to the gentle rise and fall of the waves, letting each wave remind you to let go... Continue breathing naturally, allowing the out-breath to release any remaining tension... Let the beach hold you as you rest in this moment...

Let your attention drift to the sound of the waves rolling in and out... With each breath in, imagine drawing in a sense of spaciousness... and with each breath out, feel yourself settling deeper into the sand... Notice how the breath flows on its own, like the tide... If thoughts arise, let them be like clouds passing over the ocean... Gently return to the feeling of breathing, allowing the exhale to be a little longer, a little softer... Rest here, supported by the rhythm of the sea...

mindfulness/forest.welcome: Welcome. Let's settle into this moment together. We'll practice mindfulness, resting in the calm of a quiet forest. Allow yourself to arrive fully here, just as you are.
mindfulness/forest.completion: As this meditation comes to a close, gently carry this forest stillness with you. When you're ready, softly open your eyes and return to the space around you, feeling refreshed and at ease.
segments: Take a comfortable seat... Let your eyes close or lower your gaze... Notice the air around you, as if you've stepped into a sun-dappled forest clearing... Begin by breathing in slowly through your nose... and on the out-breath, let your shoulders soften and release... Feel the cool, fresh air as it enters... and the warm air as it leaves... Allow each exhale to be a little longer than the inhale... letting go of any tension with each release.

As you settle deeper into the forest clearing, bring your attention to the natural rhythm of your breath... Feel the cool, fresh air as it flows in... and the warm, gentle release as it flows out... Let each inhale fill you with the peaceful energy of the trees... and each exhale carry away any remaining tension... Notice the soft ground beneath you, supporting you fully... The dappled sunlight rests on your skin... A gentle breeze passes through the pines... Allow your breath to become smooth and effortless... simply being present in this quiet woodland space.

Now bring your awareness to the sounds of the forest... The soft rustle of leaves in the breeze... a distant bird call... the gentle whisper of the wind through the branches... As you listen, continue to breathe in slowly, drawing in the calm of this woodland... and breathe out, releasing any effort... Let your breath flow naturally, like a stream winding through the trees... Notice the rise and fall of your chest with each breath... the subtle movement of air at your nostrils... Stay present with each inhale... and each longer, softer exhale... allowing the forest sounds to cradle you in stillness.

mindfulness/garden.welcome: Welcome. Let's settle into this moment together, allowing the mind to rest and the body to soften as we begin a gentle mindfulness practice in a peaceful garden setting.
mindfulness/garden.completion: As this practice comes to a close, take a moment to notice how you feel. Carry this sense of calm with you as you gently return your awareness to the space around you, knowing you can return to this garden of mindfulness whenever you wish.
segments: Begin by finding a comfortable position, either seated or lying down. Allow your eyes to close gently if that feels right for you. Take a slow, soft breath in through your nose, feeling your chest and belly expand... and then release the breath slowly, letting your shoulders drop and your jaw relax. Notice the natural rhythm of your breathing, without trying to change it. Now bring your awareness to the idea of a garden around you... perhaps feel the gentle warmth of sunlight on your skin... and the soft earth beneath you. Continue breathing naturally, letting each out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath, releasing any tension with each exhale.

Now, allow your attention to rest on the sounds of this garden... perhaps the soft rustle of leaves, the distant hum of insects, or the gentle trickle of water nearby. There is nothing you need to do, simply receive these sounds as they come and go. Continue with your slow breathing... breathing in the calm of the garden, and breathing out any remaining tightness from your body. Notice how the air feels as it enters your nostrils... cool on the inhale, warmer on the exhale. Let each breath draw you deeper into stillness, as the garden cradles you in quiet presence.

Bring your awareness now to the sensation of your breath moving through your body... feel the gentle rise and fall of your chest, the soft expansion of your ribs with each inhale. In the garden, imagine a gentle breeze passing through, and let your breath synchronize with that easy rhythm... breathing in as the breeze touches your face, and breathing out as it moves away. Allow your belly to soften completely, releasing any holding on the exhale. Notice if any thoughts arise, and simply let them drift by like clouds above the garden... returning again and again to the steady, calming flow of your breath.

breathing/ocean.welcome: Welcome. Let's arrive together by the ocean... settle into a comfortable position, letting your shoulders soften... and bring your awareness to the gentle rhythm of the waves nearby.
breathing/ocean.completion: As we complete this meditation... let the calm of the ocean stay with you... take one more soft breath, and when you're ready, gently return your attention to the room.
segments: Feel the ground beneath you, stable and wide... imagine a quiet beach at sunrise... breathe in slowly through your nose, drawing in the cool, salty air... and let the out-breath flow softly, longer than the in-breath, like a wave receding... feel your body settle a little more with each breath.

Notice the gentle rise and fall of your chest, like the tide meeting the shore... let your next inhale arrive as a soft wave rolling in... fill your belly slowly with the ocean air... and exhale fully, releasing any tension, letting the wave pull back out to sea... with each breath, feel the warmth of the morning sun on your skin, and allow your whole body to soften into the sand.

Let your attention rest on the sound of the waves... a slow, steady rhythm that mirrors your breath... as you inhale, imagine the water spreading up the sand toward you... and as you exhale, watch it glide back, carrying away any heaviness... keep your inhale gentle and spacious... and let your exhale extend a little longer, like the last ripple of a wave before it disappears... with each breath, feel more at ease, more connected to this peaceful shore.

breathing/mountain.welcome: Welcome... Let's take this time to arrive and settle... Together, we'll explore the steady presence of a mountain... and the gentle rhythm of your breath... There is nothing to do except allow yourself to be here... breathing... and imagining...
breathing/mountain.completion: As we come to a close... take a final slow breath in... and out... Carry this mountain stillness with you... soft and steady... Whenever you need, return to this breath... this quiet strength... May you move forward with ease... and a calm heart.
segments: Allow your body to settle into a comfortable position... feeling the support beneath you... Bring your awareness to your breath... noticing the cool air entering... and the warmer air leaving... with each breath, imagine the base of a mountain... solid and grounded... breathing in slowly... and letting the out-breath lengthen... like a gentle wind moving over the slopes... simply rest here... breathing and being...

Now bring your attention a little deeper... as if sensing the whole mountain rising from the earth... steady and still... Let your in-breath feel like a soft mist drifting up the slopes... and your out-breath like a slow, settling sigh... breathing in fully... and allowing the out-breath to release just a little longer... With each breath, feel your body becoming more still... more rooted... like the mountain resting in its own quiet strength... keep breathing gently... and noticing the calm that grows with each exhale...

Let your awareness now rest at the very center of the mountain... a place of deep quiet and steadiness... Feel your breath moving like a gentle current through hidden caves... in slowly... and out even more slowly... As you breathe, imagine the mountain's timeless patience entering you... softening the shoulders... calming the mind... There is nowhere to go, nothing to fix... just the mountain and your breath... breathing together... in... and out... letting the breath be your guide to this inner stillness...

breathing/garden.welcome: Welcome. Find a comfortable position and let your eyes softly close... Take a slow, gentle breath in through your nose... and release it with a sigh, letting your shoulders relax... Allow yourself to arrive in this moment.
breathing/garden.completion: As this meditation comes to a close, gently bring your awareness back to the space around you... Notice the ground beneath you and the air on your skin... Carry the calm of the garden with you as you continue your day.
segments: Imagine yourself standing at the edge of a peaceful garden... As you breathe in, draw in the fresh, fragrant air... and as you breathe out, let any tension melt into the earth... With each breath, feel the garden welcoming you... breathing in calm... breathing out ease...

Notice a gentle path winding through the garden... As you breathe in, feel the soft earth beneath your feet... and as you breathe out, let your steps become lighter... Perhaps a flower nearby catches your attention, its petals moving with a slow breeze... Breathe in its delicate fragrance... and breathe out any remaining tightness... Let the garden's quiet presence flow through you with each breath...

Now imagine a quiet bench beneath a flowering tree... As you breathe in, feel the shade cool and soothing around you... and as you breathe out, let your body settle into the seat... Listen to the soft rustle of leaves above... Breathe in that gentle whisper... and breathe out the busyness of the day... The garden holds you in this peaceful moment, breath by breath...

breathing/forest.welcome: Welcome. Find a comfortable position, and allow your eyes to close or soften. We'll spend a few moments breathing together, letting the calm of a forest settle around us.
breathing/forest.completion: As we bring this meditation to a close, take one last gentle breath in... and let it go. Carry this sense of forest calm with you as you return to your day.
segments: Begin to notice your breath... let the air flow in through your nose... and out through your mouth... as if the forest air is clearing your mind... Let each inhale bring the cool, fresh scent of pine... and each exhale release any tension... Breathe in slowly... and let the out-breath lengthen... Imagine sunlight filtering through the leaves... settling on your shoulders... Just breathing here... among the trees...

Let your breathing settle into an easy rhythm... as if you are breathing with the forest itself... Feel the ground beneath you, steady like the roots of an old tree... With each inhale, draw in the quiet strength of the woods... and with each exhale, soften your shoulders... your jaw... your hands... Notice the play of light and shadow across your eyelids... like leaves moving gently in the breeze... Let the forest sounds fade into the background... or imagine the distant murmur of a stream... breathing in stillness... breathing out ease... allowing your body to rest deeper into this moment...

Allow your breath to become even softer now... as if you are resting in a sun-dappled clearing... Each inhale fills you with the warmth of the light... each exhale lets you sink a little more into the earth below... Notice the space between the trees... and the space within your own body... Let your out-breath carry away any remaining weight... like leaves drifting to the forest floor... There is nothing to do... just breathing... and being held by this peaceful woodland... Your mind may wander... gently guide it back to the breath... like a path winding through the trees... returning to this moment... this breath... this stillness...

bodyScan/ocean.welcome: Welcome. I'm glad you're here. In this short body scan meditation, we'll use the calming imagery of an ocean beach. There's no need to do anything perfectly... just allow yourself to be present as you are.
bodyScan/ocean.completion: As we bring this meditation to a close, take a final slow breath in... and as you breathe out, let your awareness return to the space around you. Carry this sense of calm with you, like the gentle rhythm of the ocean. When you're ready, softly open your eyes.
segments: Settle into a comfortable position... whether sitting or lying down. Let your eyes close softly if that feels right... Take a slow breath in through your nose... and as you breathe out, let go of any tension you're carrying. Imagine yourself on a quiet ocean beach... the sand warm beneath you, the sound of gentle waves nearby. Now bring your attention down to your feet... notice any sensations there, maybe a slight tingling or warmth... just observing without needing to change anything.

Now let your awareness slowly rise from your feet... up through your ankles... into the muscles of your lower legs. As you breathe in, imagine the cool ocean breeze moving through your legs... and as you breathe out, let any tightness there soften... Maybe you notice the gentle rhythm of the waves... each wave rolling in and out... matching the natural pace of your breath. There is nothing to force... just noticing... letting the breath flow easily... and as you exhale, feel your calves and shins gently relax... releasing into the support beneath you.

Let your awareness drift up now... to your knees and the surrounding area. Perhaps you feel the gentle warmth of the sun on your skin... or the soft sea air. Breathe in slowly... and as you breathe out, invite your knees to soften and settle... Allow your thighs to feel heavy and relaxed... like sand sinking gently under your weight. Each breath can be a wave... rising and falling naturally... carrying away any effort. There is no need to control the breath... just let it come and go as it will... and notice the calm spreading through your legs.
